title: Scarlet Rot Sculk
description: Elden-Ring-based reskin of sculk and the warden
body:
This pack replaces sculk with the scarlet rot from Elden Ring. All sculk-related items are changed to fit, and the Warden is replaced with Malenia. Other changed items include:

Echo shard = Rune Arc
Recovery compass = "Insight of Grace" (which I just made up)
Disc 5 = Malenia, Blade of Miquella (Phase 2)
Mourner pot sherd = Valkyrie pot sherd
Ward armor trim = Butterfly armor trim
Silence armor trim = Pestilence armor trim (only the name is changed)

Feel free to rearrange, delete, or modify the files in this pack however you want, as long as you don't publicly release any of my files.
